summary.headline: Astrological Judgments and Bodily Rulerships
summary.text: Entries 365–383 of a Florentine astrological codex, covering arts, surgery, purging, seasons, planetary years, zodiacal years, wine, gifts, sex of the newborn, diseases, inception timing, Hermes Trismegistus’s method, agriculture, weather, solstitial lots, air, stellar actions, and bodily rulerships. The section cites Syrus and cross-references codex 12, folio 144r.
